Its tags are db5k, dbt, distribuzione-energia, eu, nodo-rete-elettrica. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
